🔥 PiX Ultimate Adobo Recipe (Serves 8) 🔥
🛑 INGREDIENTS (A Flavor Explosion in Every Bite!)

🐔 1.5 kg (3.3 lbs) chicken (cut into serving pieces)
🍍 1 cup pineapple tidbits (with ½ cup of its syrup)
🍌 1 cup banana blossoms (rinsed & soaked in water to remove bitterness)
🫙 ½ cup soy sauce (the classic Adobo base!)
🥥 ½ cup tuba vinegar (coconut vinegar) (for that authentic island taste!)
💦 1 ½ cups water
🫘 1 sachet black beans (drained & rinsed)
🐓 1 chicken bouillon cube (dissolved in 1 ½ cups hot water)
🦪 1 sachet oyster sauce (approx. 1-2 tbsp, for extra umami!)
🐟 1 tbsp fish sauce (patis) (optional, for added depth)
🧄 1 whole garlic head (crushed or minced)
🧅 1 large onion (sliced)
🫚 2 tbsp ginger (julienned, optional for extra aroma)
🍯 2 tbsp brown sugar (adjust for desired sweetness)
🌶 1 tsp ground black pepper
🍃 1 cup dahon ng paminta (pepper leaves) (as a substitute for bay leaves!)
✨ 1 small pack Magic Sarap (for an instant boost of flavor!)
🥄 1 small pack Ginisa Mix (for enhanced sautéed goodness!)
🔥 3 tbsp cooking oil
🔥 HOW TO COOK PiX ULTIMATE ADOBO™ – THE NEXT-LEVEL PINOY DISH! 🔥
1️⃣ Prep the Special Ingredients – Start the Magic!

🍌 Rinse and soak the banana blossoms for 5-10 minutes to remove bitterness, then drain.
🍃 Wash the pepper leaves (dahon ng paminta) and set them aside.
🫘 Drain and rinse the black beans to remove excess salt.
2️⃣ Marinate the Chicken – Flavor Infusion!

🥩 In a large bowl, combine chicken, soy sauce, garlic, and ground black pepper.
🕐 Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes, or overnight for a deeper flavor!
3️⃣ Sauté the Aromatics – Unlock the Flavor!

🔥 Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat.
🧅 Sauté onions, ginger (if using), and remaining garlic until fragrant.
🧂 Add Ginisa Mix to enhance the sautéed flavors—this is our secret weapon!
4️⃣ Brown the Chicken – Seal in the Goodness!
🍗 Add the marinated chicken (save the marinade!) and cook until browned on both sides.
5️⃣ Simmer the Sauce with Tuba Vinegar – The Secret!

💦 Dissolve 1 chicken cube in 1 ½ cups hot water and pour it into the pan.
🥥 Add the marinade, tuba vinegar, and pineapple syrup.
🔥 Let it boil without stirring for 5 minutes (important! This allows the vinegar to mellow out).
6️⃣ Add the Special Ingredients – Flavor Overload!

🦪 Stir in oyster sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, and Magic Sarap.
🍌 Add the banana blossoms, black beans, and pepper leaves.
🔥 Simmer for 10 minutes so all the flavors blend together beautifully.
7️⃣ Add Pineapple Tidbits & Reduce the Sauce – The Final Touch!

🍍 Stir in the pineapple tidbits and mix well.
🔥 Cover and let it simmer for another 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is tender and the sauce thickens.
8️⃣ Serve & Enjoy – The Moment of Truth!
🍚 Serve hot with steamed rice—prepare for the most flavorful Adobo experience of your life!
🔥 Why PiX Ultimate Adobo™ is a Must-Try? 🔥

✅ Tuba Vinegar makes the tanginess more natural & deep! 🥥
✅ Oyster Sauce enhances umami & richness! 🦪
✅ Black Beans add a salty, savory contrast! 🫘
✅ Pepper Leaves give it a fresh, aromatic twist! 🍃
✅ Magic Sarap & Ginisa Mix bring out the ultimate Filipino flavors! 🇵🇭🔥
